title: Industrial policy, the manufacturing sector and black empowerment in South Africa
publisher: Transformation: Critical Perspectives on Southern Africa 109, 80–111
summary: Black Economic Empowerment has been an ambitious project, but results in key sectors have fallen short. The paper asks why South Africa has not seen the emergence of a large, economically significant black industrialist class, and whether industrial policy has helped or undermined deep transformation.
keyFindings: Results of BEE in key sectors, including manufacturing, have fallen short.
The paper identifies key limitations of BEE and of the industrial policy framework.
It considers how industrial transformation could be accelerated.
methods: Policy analysis of the interaction between BEE and industrial policy in South African manufacturing.
